content.prompt:
Let $A=\{\text{positive even numbers less than }101\}$.

Notate the set $A$ in two different ways.

answer.worked:
A roster lists the even-number pattern:
$$A=\{2,4,6,\ldots,100\}.$$
In set-builder notation, $\frac{x}{2}\in\mathbb Z$ requires an even integer, and $0<x<101$ imposes the bounds:
$$A=\left\{x\in\mathbb Z\text{ where }\frac{x}{2}\in\mathbb Z\text{ and }0<x<101\right\}.$$
